polityNote: Upper Volta (Burkina Faso from 1984-08-04), independence 1960-08-05 to the day before the ne-admin1 dossier (BFA.json, 1997-01). Atoms: geoBoundaries BFA ADM2 2017 (World Bank, CC BY 4.0) — the 45 provinces of 1997 onward. A 1984 province is drawn only where every 1996 province formed from it lists it alone as its former province (Statoids «Formerly»); the 15 provinces redistributed among several 1996 provinces need department atoms. ⚠ geoBoundaries BFA ADM3 (2007, the department level) cannot serve: its names do not match its shapes (2026-10-06: the shape named Ouagadougou lies at 2.63°W 11.30°N, about 150 km from the city; the seven shapes inside the 2017 Kadiogo province are named Bekuy, Bereba, Boni, Koussouka, Ndorola, Thyou, Zogore, departments of five other provinces). ① check: union areas against the 1985 areas (Statoids, 1984 table) — Bam 4,026/4,017 (1.00), Ganzourgou 4,182/4,087 (1.02), Gnagna 8,561/8,600 (1.00), Kossi 13,434/13,177 (1.02), Naouri 3,913/3,843 (1.02), Oudalan 10,045/10,046 (1.00), Passoré 3,996/4,078 (0.98), Poni 10,338/10,361 (1.00), Sanguié 5,131/5,165 (0.99), Sanmatenga 9,309/9,213 (1.01), Séno 13,570/13,473 (1.01), Soum 12,673/13,350 (0.95; fr.wikipedia's 1985 density gives 12,226 → 1.04), Sourou 9,780/9,487 (1.03), Tapoa 14,861/14,780 (1.01), Yatenga 12,473/12,292 (1.01); 1974 departments against the 1975 areas — Sahel 36,288/36,869 (0.98), Nord 12,473/12,293 (1.01).
